data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 184.673m. No explicit gross prior-year (pre-2019) reserve movement is stated in the notes; a gross claims development triangle is provided but a clean, unambiguous prior-year release/strengthening figure for 2018-and-older cannot be directly extracted from the published movement notes. The 2020 result was driven by several medium-sized natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Laura and Sally, the Iowa Derecho and an Alberta hailstorm) which produced net losses to the syndicate, and management also established a gross COVID-19 related reserve of GBP 10.9m (net GBP 9.8m). Commutation/return premium activity (a GBP 49m return premium related to a whole account quota share with Syndicate 1955) and other movements in reinsurance arrangements materially affected the year and complicate a clean prior-year development read across.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss for the year is the result of several medium sized events in 2020 which were largely under the attachment point of our catastrophe outwards protections and therefore a net loss to the syndicate.
In particular hurricanes Laura and Sally, the Iowa Derecho and the hailstorm in Alberta caused significant losses.
The overall gross COVID-19 reserve for the syndicate is GBP 10.9m, while the net reserve is GBP 9.8m with the majority coming from the Property Treaty account.
In addition, a return premium of GBP 49m net was paid to Syndicate 1955 in relation to the commutation of the whole account quota share on the 2017 & prior years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was found in the notes. A gross claims development triangle is present (used for some cross-checking) but deriving a single authoritative gross prior-year development figure (2018-and-earlier) from the triangle is ambiguous here (the earliest underwriting year lacks an older-diagonal reference and the syndicate effected commutations/return premium and a Part VII transfer during the year which distort comparatives). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as null. Some line-by-line LOB movements were inferred by comparing gross liabilities at 31/12/2020 vs 31/12/2019 (gross liabilities by LOB are shown) and are provided with moderate confidence. COVID-19 reserves (GBP 10.9m gross; GBP 9.8m net) and a GBP 49m return premium to Syndicate 1955 materially affect the 2020 comparative positions and may distort simple year-on-year reserve movement measures.
